name: @multiplatformmsg/core
description: MultiPlatformMsg local core skeleton and in-memory tenant boundary verification

scripts.test:provision-marker: node -e "const { PrismaClient } = require('@prisma/client'); const p = new PrismaClient(); const token = process.env.TEST_DATABASE_MARKER_TOKEN || 'multiplatformmsg_dedicated_test_instance_token'; p.$executeRawUnsafe('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \""__multiplatformmsg_test_marker__\"" (\""marker_key\"" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, \""marker_token\"" TEXT NOT NULL, \""created_at\"" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);').then(() => p.$executeRawUnsafe('INSERT INTO \""__multiplatformmsg_test_marker__\"" (\""marker_key\"", \""marker_token\"") VALUES (\x27TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PERMITTED\x27, \x27' + token + '\x27) ON CONFLICT (\""marker_key\"") DO UPDATE SET \""marker_token\"" = EXCLUDED.\""marker_token\"";')).then(() => { console.log('Test marker provisioned successfully.'); return p.$disconnect(); }).catch(e => { console.error('Marker provisioning failed', e); process.exit(1); });"
